fact: The 2019-2021 DHS finds that 45% of children under 5 had their birth registered with the civil registry (68% urban, 30% rural; 36% hold a birth certificate), well below 90%.
title: Enquête Démographique et de Santé de la Mauritanie (EDSM) 2019-2021
publisher: Office National de la Statistique (ONS), Ministère de la Santé, The DHS Program
